title: tephrosia oxygona subsp. lactea
intro: Tephrosia oxygona subsp. lactea, commonly known as the yellow leaf bean, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family, characterized by its yellow-colored leaves and various medicinal uses. The health benefits of Tephrosia oxygona subsp. lactea include its potential in lowering blood sugar levels, improving cardiovascular health, and possessing anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a diuretic, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory agent, which can be beneficial in treating conditions such as hypertension and arthritis. The bioactive constituents of Tephrosia oxygona subsp. lactea include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
